Chimpanzee_Large_Cupped_Ears.description: This large, cupped ear component, a marvel of primate evolution, enhances the wearer's auditory senses, allowing them to detect the faintest whispers of the wind and distant threats, while also bestowing a heightened sense of awareness and wisdom, making them acutely attuned to their surroundings.

Lemur_Tufted_Hearing_Cones.description: The tufted hearing cones of the Lemur are a marvel of evolutionary adaptation, with large, swiveling ears that can detect the faintest of sounds, granting the creature unparalleled awareness and agility in the dense jungle canopy.

Gorilla_Small_Flat_Ears.description: These small, flat ears, nestled close to the gorilla's head, enhance its natural perception and provide a subtle layer of armor, granting the primate an acute awareness of its surroundings and resilience against sonic attacks.

Tarsier_Giant_Bat_Like_Ears.description: The Tarsier Giant Bat Like Ears are prehensile and exquisitely sensitive, capable of rotating a full 360 degrees to detect the faintest sounds and subtle vibrations, granting the bearer an unparalleled sense of awareness and the ability to perceive threats from all directions.

Mandrill_Colorful_Ear_Tufts.description: The Mandrill's colorful ear tufts, a vibrant spectacle of nature, not only enhance its charisma and perception but also grant it the innate skills of Charm and Alert, making it a mesmerizing and observant creature in the dark and mystical realm.

Spider_Monkey_Pointed_Ears.description: Bristling with keen senses and lithe grace, the Spider_Monkey_Pointed_Ears component endows its bearer with elongated, highly attuned ears that twitch and swivel with remarkable agility, enhancing their perception and ability to evade danger.

Baboon_Angular_Listening_Muffs.description: These angular listening muffs, modeled after the keen ears of a baboon, amplify the wearer's auditory senses, allowing them to detect the faintest rustles and whispers with uncanny precision, while also granting a heightened awareness of their surroundings, making them a prized asset in the dense, treacherous jungles of the realm.

Gibbon_Round_Acoustic_Catchers.description: These delicate yet resilient acoustic catchers, finely tuned to the frequencies of the forest, enhance the primate's keen senses and nimbleness, allowing it to detect the slightest sounds and movements with uncanny precision.

Spectral_Ape_Whispering_Ears.description: Spectral Ape Whispering Ears, a cephalon component with the essence of an otherworldly primate, grants its bearer heightened wisdom and perception, allowing them to listen to the whispers of arcane secrets and detect the faintest traces of magic in the air.

Zombie_Primate_Torn_Ear_Flaps.description: Tattered and flayed, the zombie primate's ears flap loosely, their ragged edges fluttering with the creature's every movement, enhancing its acute awareness and granting it a twisted resilience against venomous attacks.
